scripts.build: prisma generate && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/copy-assets.js
scripts.setup: npm run stack:up && npm run db:reset && npm run db:test:prepare
scripts.dev:stack: concurrently -k -n api,dtb -c blue,magenta "dotenv -e .env.stack.local -e .env.stack -- tsx watch src/index.ts" "npm:mock:dtb"
scripts.dev:stack:mock: concurrently -k -n api,dtb -c blue,magenta "dotenv -e .env.stack.mock -e .env.stack.local -e .env.stack -- tsx watch src/index.ts" "npm:mock:dtb"
scripts.db:seed: dotenv -e .env.stack -- node scripts/assert-local-db.mjs && dotenv -e .env.stack -- tsx prisma/seed.ts
scripts.db:seed:demo: dotenv -e .env.stack -- node scripts/assert-local-db.mjs && dotenv -e .env.stack -- tsx prisma/seed-demo.ts
scripts.db:reset: dotenv -e .env.stack -- node scripts/assert-local-db.mjs && dotenv -e .env.stack -- prisma migrate reset --force && npm run db:seed && npm run db:seed:demo
scripts.db:test:prepare: dotenv -e .env.test -- node scripts/assert-local-db.mjs && dotenv -e .env.test -- prisma migrate reset --force && dotenv -e .env.test -- tsx prisma/seed.ts
scripts.db:e2e:prepare: dotenv -e .env.e2e -- node scripts/assert-local-db.mjs && dotenv -e .env.e2e -- prisma migrate reset --force && dotenv -e .env.e2e -- tsx prisma/seed.ts && dotenv -e .env.e2e -- tsx prisma/seed-demo.ts
